producer_contract.policy: Agent3 must not copy, infer, or guess producer fields; a versioned reviewed adapter is required
producer_contract.potential_design: hard/soft initial tip x 5/8-step loading-history 2x2 factorial
producer_contract.potential_status: awaiting Agent2 signed bundle and split

physics_reference.synthetic_real_boundary: FEM trajectories remain synthetic numerical references and are never labelled real-road validation

observed_state_same_regime_h1_h3.input: observed or assimilated state at a hash-locked origin with identical observation, mask, time, load, environment, maintenance and scenario conditioning
observed_state_same_regime_h1_h3.eligibility: all targets remain inside the producer-declared event regime

autonomous_transition_warning.input: observed state before a producer-declared transition with future scenario information available at forecast time
autonomous_transition_warning.output: transition probability or warning state, not an unlimited deterministic field rollout
autonomous_transition_warning.claim: transition warning under held-out within-Hard5 numerical trajectories

observation_reset_conditional_propagatio.input: hash-locked post-observation assimilated state at or after transition
observation_reset_conditional_propagatio.claim: conditional propagation after a new observation; never autonomous transition discovery

hard_rules: all cycles and observation resets from a held-out independence group remain outside training and normalization
same-trajectory cycle windows never count as independent samples
normalization statistics are fitted inside each outer training fold only
no held-out trajectory is used for context, checkpoint, threshold or architecture selection
if any selection remains necessary, add an inner trajectory-level split before training

fem_centred_metrics.missing_policy: unavailable uncertainty remains unavailable and never becomes zero variance
fem_centred_metrics.aggregation: report every held-out trajectory first, then paired aggregate versus matched Markov

long_horizon.field_output: rolling h1-h3 after each new observed or assimilated state
long_horizon.rul_output: RUL distribution only when event/censor and calibration gates pass
long_horizon.forbidden_claim: free recursive rollout is a road long-horizon prediction

readiness_release_gate: task2 signed contract/split path, schema id, adapter id and SHA256 are frozen
a reviewed adapter maps the producer contract into the Agent3 normalized inventory
all four hard/soft x 5/8-step combinations pass mechanism completeness, hash and provenance validation
every trajectory covers all three pre-registered tasks
observation and future scenario contracts are identical across compared models
road-aware parameter counts pass the one-percent gate
seeds, steps, optimizer, loss, origins, masks and future scenarios are frozen
hazard/RUL remains unavailable unless calibrated uncertainty and event/censor diversity pass
